title: Faster inference for difficult BSM parameter spaces
description: Developing machine-learning-assisted inference methods that can make high-dimensional and multi-modal parameter searches more computationally tractable, while retaining the strengths of established sampling methods.

title: Lightweight machine learning for jet tagging
description: Designing and comparing efficient image-, graph-, and attention-based models for identifying boosted objects in collider data, with an emphasis on useful performance without unnecessary computational cost.

title: Likelihood-weighted amortized inference
description: Exploring ways for generative models to learn posterior structure so that repeated inference can become much faster once the model has been trained.

title: Scalable transformer architectures for jet tagging
description: Investigating modular transformer designs for collider applications, with attention to scalability, efficiency, and practical deployment.
